name: jsontest-d8d6aef1f4/json-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.string does not list fromJsonString, ballerina/lang.value does not list toJsonString, and ballerina/lang.error lists only message.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; the list includes map:keys, map:remove and error:message but excludes fromJsonString, toJsonString and error:detail.
reason: The case requires JSON serialization and parsing through msg.toJsonString() and jsonStr.fromJsonString(), neither of which is in the supported langlib or method-call positive lists. It also inspects malformed-input error details using detail(), which is excluded. These essential calls make the whole case a feature even though its map removal, key access, casts and constructors are supported.
unsupported_constructs: fromJsonString() JSON parsing, including malformed-input rejection
error.detail() and asserted parser diagnostic detail
test_design_notes: The malformed-input branch asserts the exact parser diagnostic message.
io:println is output instrumentation and does not determine the classification.
